name: voicestudio-plugin
description: Let Claude speak, generate speech files, transcribe audio and clone voices through the local VoiceStudio app: the voicestudio MCP server (plays audio on your Mac, returns file paths instead of base64) plus the voice-studio skill for expressive, natural-sounding speech.

port.title: VoiceStudio port
port.description: Loopback port of the VoiceStudio backend (the app's API). VoiceStudio uses 3900 unless you changed it.

language.title: Speech language
language.description: Default language for speech: an ISO 639 code such as lv, en or de, or Auto to let VoiceStudio detect it from the text.

voice.title: Default voice
voice.description: Voice profile name or ID from VoiceStudio. Leave empty to use VoiceStudio's default voice.

steps.title: Diffusion steps
steps.description: Quality versus speed: 16 is fast, 24 balanced, 32 studio quality.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Folder where generated audio files are saved. Leave empty for ~/Music/VoiceStudio.

auto_launch.title: Start VoiceStudio automatically
auto_launch.description: When the backend does not answer, open VoiceStudio.app in the background and wait for it to be ready.
